hypotheses.P0_top32_graph_is_selection_stable: The independently selected top-32 edge sets have Jaccard overlap at least 0.50.
hypotheses.P1_both_top32_graphs_are_sufficient: Both independently selected top-32 graphs lie within 0.05 fidelity of the full natural rank-32 program on every corpus.
hypotheses.P2_function_is_more_stable_than_edges: At top 32, the two selections differ by at most 0.05 fidelity on every corpus even if their edge Jaccard is below 0.80.
hypotheses.P3_selected_graphs_beat_random_null: At top 32, both selected graphs exceed the 95th percentile of 20 matched random graphs by at least 0.20 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.P4_top16_is_sufficient: Both independently selected top-16 graphs lie within 0.05 of the full program on every corpus.
